nativeEligibility.status: Native acrylic companion remains rejected after rectangular leakage; the layered wheel has an independent custom desktop-refraction path with opaque fallback
nativeEligibility.nativeImplementation: WPF per-pixel alpha contours; supported DWM backdrop API retained for isolated diagnostics; undocumented accent interop removed

desktopRefraction.implementation: Shared Windows Graphics Capture monitor sessions / native D3D11 four-pass RGBA16F Studio optics; padded GPU ROI; final premultiplied BGRA region readback; reused WPF bitmap
desktopRefraction.dependencies: Windows system DLLs only; no additional redistributable or NuGet dependency
desktopRefraction.sampleScope: Visible admitted wheel or app-owned glass surface only; monitor texture remains GPU-only; only finished presentation region read back; no persistence or transmission
desktopRefraction.exclusion: Reference-counted WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE on participating owned HWNDs, checked setter/readback, compositor timestamp invalidation after affinity changes
desktopRefraction.borderless: Unpackaged full-trust distribution only; RequestAccessAsync(Borderless) must return Allowed, cursor disabled, IsBorderRequired false before StartCapture
desktopRefraction.fallback: Opaque contour on policy denial, unsupported capture layout, exclusion failure, protected content, device/access loss or missing first frame
desktopRefraction.qualification: Owned native optical capability proof is recorded separately from pure renderer tests

opticalReference.adaptations: Exact Citrus contours; bounded shoulders and sampling; finite guards; DIP-stable normals; clamped lighting blend factors; final gamut conversion and premultiplication
